verdicts.notes: Severity S1/P1 kept: the rubric puts any real, reachable security exposure at S1, and this one is a public link away (Pages 'Deploy from a branch', main, root: docs/STEP6_SPEC.md:206-208; the route documented live at docs/STAGE8_SPEC.md:4882-4884, 5165). Its practical impact is bounded (one click by the victim; the map stores nothing: no localStorage/sessionStorage/indexedDB/cookie in app.js; whether other Pages sites of the account share the origin now was not checked, the GitHub API being closed to this session). Two corrections to the record, not to the verdict: the remedy's 'also removes R-6' should read R-8 (R-6 is the gait hook's test; R-8 is the archived builds on Pages); and the remedy's second option, publishing only the product on Pages, would take the device route off the host the owner's device protocol uses (STAGE8_SPEC.md:4882-4884, 5165) unless the artifact also carries tools/step6/: the first option (same origin, http(s), assign the parsed u.href) keeps every documented use, all relative same-origin paths (STAGE8_SPEC.md:4672, STEP6_SPEC.md:1275). Not checked: WebKit/Gecko (not installed; the HTML spec runs a same-origin initiator's javascript: navigation in the frame's initial about:blank, which inherits the parent's origin, so the same is expected); data: not re-tested (the area's case shows it blocked).
